title: Swiss catalog settings
description: catalog.yaml: settings for the catalog as a whole, published in index.json.

site.description: Where the catalog's site is published, perf reports included at <site>models/<name>/<report>. Ends in a slash, so joining a path onto it is unambiguous.

raw.description: Where files are fetched raw at a commit, as <raw><commit>/<path>. Defaults to raw.githubusercontent.com for a GitHub repo.
